description: Add a getErrorSummary(error) helper function to src/llm.js that returns a short one-line string summarising an LLM error: include the provider name, HTTP status if present, and whether it was a rate limit

contract.raw_request: Add a getErrorSummary(error) helper function to src/llm.js that returns a short one-line string summarising an LLM error: include the provider name, HTTP status if present, and whether it was a rate limit
contract.goal: Implement a helper function getErrorSummary in src/llm.js that returns a concise error summary for LLM errors, including provider name, HTTP status, and rate limit status.
required_behavior: The function getErrorSummary should take an error object as input and return a string in the format: 'Provider: [provider_name], Status: [status], Rate Limit: [true/false]'
constraints: The function must not modify existing code outside of adding this new functionality.
The function must handle cases where the HTTP status is missing.
The function must return null or a default string if the error object is missing required fields.
The function must not introduce new bugs or regressions in the application.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: getErrorSummary must return a string in the format: Provider: [provider_name], Status: [status], Rate Limit: [true/false]
getErrorSummary must handle cases where the HTTP status is missing
getErrorSummary must not introduce new bugs or regressions

verification_plan: Run unit tests for getErrorSummary with various error objects, including missing HTTP status.
Verify that the function does not alter existing code or introduce new bugs.
Test error cases where HTTP status is missing or present.
